_comment: Each entry is keyed by its id, which names the inserted node (id_1, id_2, ...).
'label' is the menu text. Keep the two separate: renaming a menu entry must not
rename anyone's nodes. 'lines' are the INI body; the [node.<name>] header is
generated from the id, not stored here. %%X%% and %%Y%% become map coordinates.
Templates must insert a node the engine can actually RUN, so a modeller can
check a model steps through before calibrating anything. Rainfall-runoff params
are plausible starting values, not zeros. Tables carry enough rows to interpolate.
Comments are '#' or ';' -- never '//', which the engine parses as part of the value.
Parameters that take an expression are marked '#expression' so it is clear they

gr4j.label: GR4J
lines: params = 1500, 4, 65, 0.38 #x1 mm, x2 mm, x3 mm, x4 days

storage.label: Storage
lines: dimensions = 0,  0,    0,  0,    # Level m, Volume ML, Area km2, Spill ML (Ctrl+T for table viewer)

loss.label: Loss
lines: table = 0,   0,   # Inflow ML, Loss ML (Ctrl+T for table viewer)

splitter.label: Splitter
lines: table = 0,   0,   # Inflow ML, ds_2 flow ML (Ctrl+T for table viewer)
